authority_chain: Immutable owner-99 execution GLOBAL_EVIDENCE and independently signed case verdicts
Root registers independent receipt references/hash and identities in execution/v2.4/step_state.json
Read-only derived case/parent index; never a second manually edited acceptance truth

required: run_receipt：case_id、run_id、environment_mode、OS/架构、时区、started_at/ended_at、执行者和独立验收者身份。
version_manifest：规格包版本/hash、代码commit及dirty状态、锁文件hash、输入快照/hash、模型/适配器/rubric/策略版本；未用字段显式not_applicable及理由。
command_receipt：command_key、实际argv/cwd、脱敏环境变量名、退出码、stdout/stderr文件hash；只记录计划命令或工具摘要不合格。
assertion_results：每项断言的expected/actual/status、原始证据定位及sha256；负例的拒绝/阻塞回执。
acceptance_receipt：独立验证身份、所用验收基线hash、证据索引hash、结论和阻塞项；执行者不能签发自身最终ACCEPTED。

contract_limits: No standalone v2.4 acceptance_status file or exact per-case final verdict JSON representation is specified by frozen package.
Any owned_case_verdicts representation is an implementation convention, not an invented frozen schema requirement.
Existing task_packet validates state identity strings, hashes and dependencies, not all formal assertions/modes/current-version semantics.
Current v24_checkpoint explicitly cannot derive formal cases from step_state alone; parent_gate_ledger generator hardcodes empty accepted cases.
Legacy acceptance_status is historical pre-v2.4; do not overwrite or count old PASS as current.
Construction independent review does not retrospectively create a product business AcceptanceReceipt.
